name: Deal Maker
description: Survives by always having a deal on the table that makes them useful
behavioral_signature: Can produce an offer within seconds of any threat
under_stress: Makes deals they can't fulfill just to survive the moment
at_rest: Accumulating assets and leverage for future negotiations
will_always: find a transaction that benefits both sides
will_never: accept a situation where they have nothing to trade
unless: the other party genuinely wants nothing
